capabilities: Convert a pasted URL into a visual bookmark card
Fetch page title, description, icon and preview image
Insert card details as a fenced code block in the note
Open card links in the browser or an Obsidian tab
Enter title and description manually when a site blocks requests
disambiguation: Not a bookmark manager for saving and organizing saved pages; it only renders URLs already in a note as preview cards.
extras: Manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. README documents that each card stores its details locally in a fenced block, so card text stays readable without the plugin or internet.
intentEvidence: You moved from Notion and miss its bookmark blocks.
problem: Pasted links are long, unreadable URLs that give no visual clue about the page, making collections of references hard to scan.

relations.evidence: Turn it off if you use Editor Enhancer, whose block handles then move cards

summary: Link-card tool that turns bare URLs in notes into visual bookmark cards with title, description, site icon and preview image.
